# Solana Dev Skill

Solana Foundation development skill: Anchor 1.x and Pinocchio programs, @solana/kit clients, LiteSVM, Mollusk and Surfpool testing, security, Token-2022, payments.

## Use it when
- Solana programs
- Anchor
- Pinocchio
- @solana/kit
- program tests
- security review

## Install
Installed kit:

```bash
bash .claude/bin/skills.sh add solana-dev
```

No install: fetch https://aikit.superteam.codes/skills/solana-dev.md

## What's inside
- anchor: Anchor 1.x programs: accounts, constraints, CPIs, IDL.
- pinocchio: Pinocchio programs with zero-copy accounts.
- kit-clients: @solana/kit clients and transaction building.
- testing: LiteSVM, Mollusk and Surfpool test setups.
- security: Program security review checklist.
- token-2022: Token-2022 mints and extensions.
- payments: Payment flows on Solana.

## Safety review
Scanned at 674da5a: documentation and code samples only; no shell execution or network calls in the skill files.

- The scan covered every file in the pack at the pinned commit.
- No skill instructs the agent to read keypairs, wallets or environment secrets.
- Code samples that deploy programs target localnet or devnet.

## Used by
- Agents: solana-architect, anchor-engineer, pinocchio-engineer, solana-qa-engineer
- Commands: /plan-feature, /build-program, /audit-solana, /deploy

# Jupiter Agent Skills

Jupiter's official skills: integrating-jupiter (swap, lend, perps, trigger, recurring), jupiter-lend, jupiter-swap-migration, jupiter-vrfd.

## Use it when
- Jupiter
- token swaps
- Jupiter Lend
- perps
- trigger orders
- recurring orders

## Install
Installed kit:

```bash
bash .claude/bin/skills.sh add jupiter
```

No install: fetch https://aikit.superteam.codes/skills/jupiter.md

## What's inside
- integrating-jupiter: Swap, lend, perps, trigger and recurring orders.
- jupiter-lend: Jupiter Lend.
- jupiter-swap-migration: Migrating an existing swap integration.
- jupiter-vrfd: Read from the skill's SKILL.md at build.

## Safety review
Scanned at a2211e3: no shell execution, no network calls outside Jupiter's documented API hosts, and no instructions to read keypairs or secrets.

- The scan covered all four skills and their reference files at the pinned commit.
- Network access in code samples is limited to Jupiter API hosts named in the skill text.
- Swap examples build transactions for the user to sign; none sign with a local keypair.
- No obfuscated content, encoded payloads or instructions that ask the agent to change its own configuration were found.

## Used by
- Agents: defi-engineer
- Commands: /plan-feature

# anchor-engineer

Writes, tests and upgrades Anchor programs.

## Use it when
- Anchor program
- new instruction
- account constraints
- IDL changes

## How to invoke

```
Use the anchor-engineer agent to …
```

## What it does
- Implements instructions, accounts and constraints from a plan or a spec.
- Writes LiteSVM and Mollusk tests next to each instruction.
- Generates the IDL and keeps the TypeScript client in step.
- Checks compute usage with /profile-cu before handing off.

## Hands off to
- solana-qa-engineer
- solana-frontend-engineer
- tech-docs-writer

## Uses
- Skills: solana-dev
- Commands: /build-program, /test-rust, /profile-cu, /generate-idl-client

# /audit-solana

Reviews a program for Solana-specific security issues and writes a report.

## Use it when
- security review
- before mainnet
- audit

## How to invoke

```
/audit-solana [path]
```

## What it does
- Reads the program and its tests, then checks signer, owner and PDA constraints.
- Looks for unchecked arithmetic, missing close constraints and CPI pitfalls.
- Writes findings by severity, each with file and line, to audits/.
- Suggests fixes and hands them to the program's engineer agent.

## Routes to
- solana-qa-engineer

## Hands off to
- anchor-engineer
- pinocchio-engineer

## Uses
- Skills: solana-dev
